title: zexmenia strigosa
intro: Zexmenia strigosa, commonly known as Zexmenia, is a flowering plant species within the Asteraceae family, native to the Americas. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Zexmenia strigosa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective effects. The bioactive compounds in Zexmenia strigosa have been reported to include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
